g.aria-label: Selecting the Simplest Distributed Training Stack by Scale (Nov 2026)
1 GPU (≥ 8–16 GB) → 1 Node (2–8 GPUs, ≤ 30B Full Fine-Tune)
1 GPU LoRA/QLoRA: Unsloth or HF PEFT · 1 Node
Few Nodes (16–64 GPUs) → Many Nodes (64–512+ GPUs, 3D/4D Pretraining)
Few Nodes: PyTorch FSDP2 + torchrun or DeepSpeed
· Many Nodes: TorchTitan, Megatron Core, MaxText
RL Post-Training (DPO / GRPO Policy + Rollout Generation Loops)
Single Node: HF TRL · Multi-Node Disaggregated
